title: System & Network Suite
description: Essential diagnostic tools, network monitoring, and port checkers

buttons.name: Network Ping Test
buttons.description: Pings a target domain or IP address

buttons.name: Check Active Port
buttons.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort {{port}} -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, OwningProcess, State | Format-Table -AutoSize
buttons.description: Checks if a port is currently listening or occupied

buttons.name: System Info & Uptime
buttons.command: $os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; [PSCustomObject]@{ Computer = $env:COMPUTERNAME; OS = $os.Caption; Version = $os.Version; RAM_GB = [math]::Round($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize/1MB, 2); LastBoot = $os.LastBootUpTime } | Format-List
buttons.description: Inspect OS version, RAM capacity, and last boot time

buttons.name: Clean Temp Files
buttons.command: $temp = $env:TEMP; Write-Host "Checking temp folder: $temp"; Get-ChildItem $temp -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ("Total temp size: {0:N2} MB" -f ($_.Sum / 1MB)) }
buttons.description: Scans and reports Windows temporary files size

title: Developer Workspace
description: Code execution, local HTTP server, git status, and npm tools

buttons.name: Launch Static Server
buttons.description: Starts an instant HTTP server in current folder

buttons.name: Execute Node.js Code
buttons.description: Run custom Javascript code logic inside Node runtime

buttons.name: Git Status & Branch
buttons.command: git status -s && echo --- Branches --- && git branch
buttons.description: Quick view of current git repository changes and active branch

buttons.name: NPM Package Info
buttons.description: Fetches NPM registry data for any package

title: Scripting & Speech Studio
description: PowerShell speech synthesis, file directory analysis, and custom executable macros

buttons.name: Text-To-Speech Voice
buttons.description: Uses Windows SAPI speech synthesizer to talk aloud

inputs.label: Text to Speak
inputs.default: AppCraft Studio is online and ready for your commands!

buttons.name: Folder File Inspector
buttons.command: $path = '{{target_dir}}'; if(Test-Path $path){ $items = Get-ChildItem -Path $path; $files = $items | Where-Object {!$_.PSIsContainer}; $dirs = $items | Where-Object {$_.PSIsContainer}; Write-Host "Directory: $path"; Write-Host "Subfolders: ($($dirs.Count))"; Write-Host "Files: ($($files.Count))"; $files | Select-Object Name, Length, LastWriteTime | Format-Table -AutoSize } else { Write-Host "Path not found: $path" }
buttons.description: Analyzes folder structure, file counts, and sizes
